description: Copy this to .claude/settings.json and customize for your project
notes: This file cannot be committed due to Claude Code security restrictions on .claude/

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then exit 0; fi; if [[ "$f" =~ \.(yaml|yml)$ ]]; then yamllint --config-data '{rules: {line-length: {max: 120}, indentation: {spaces: 2}}}' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then exit 0; fi; if [[ "$f" =~ \.(json)$ ]]; then jq empty "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "[Hook] JSON valid" || echo "[Hook] JSON syntax error (review required)"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
